title: In the countryside
descriptionFa: چیزهایی که بیرون شهر می‌بینی، زندگی روستایی، طبیعت و حیات وحش.

words.example: We live in the city, but we spend our weekends in the countryside.
words.tipFa: با the: in the countryside. the country هم همین معنی رو می‌ده.

words.example: Damavand is the highest mountain in Iran.
Our village is at the top of a small hill.
The Hyrcanian forest in the north of Iran is very old.
We walked through a small wood to the river.
words.tipFa: wood یعنی «چوب» هم هست. the woods هم می‌گن.

words.example: There's a beautiful lake near Marivan.
The Karun is the longest river in Iran.
The farmer is working in the field.
My uncle has a farm with cows and chickens.
words.tipFa: کشاورز on a farm زندگی می‌کنه، نه in a farm.

words.example: Follow this path to the waterfall.
Drive slowly on this country road. It's very narrow.
Masuleh is a famous village in the mountains.
I grew up in a small town of about ten thousand people.
They rent a little cottage near the sea every summer.
I love nature, especially birds.
words.tipFa: بدون the: I love nature. nature یه جا نیست؛ «رفتن به طبیعت» می‌شه go to the countryside.

words.example: You can see a lot of wildlife in the mountains of the north.
You can't build houses in a conservation area.
Golestan is the oldest national park in Iran.
Let's have a picnic by the river on Friday.
We go walking in the hills every weekend.
words.tipFa: برای کوه‌پیمایی سبک hiking هم می‌گن.
